items.statement: Removing the informal physician approval step for patients who pass the safety screen and agreeing a shared 08:00 time with respiratory therapy will raise completed interruptions from 38 to 70 percent of eligible patient-days within six months, without more self-extubations.
items.rationale: Targets the waits after the screen found elsewhere (c1, c4) and keeps safety visible (c3).
items.risks: The local wait may lie elsewhere; physicians may resist losing the approval step.

items.statement: Moving the safety screen to 06:30 will reduce interruptions deferred until after rounds.
items.rationale: Deferral until after rounds is a documented reason for missed interruptions.

items.statement: Sharing self-extubation data at the daily huddle will reduce the proportion of missed interruptions attributed to agitation.
items.rationale: Fear is a main barrier and the events are rare.
items.risks: Attribution in the chart may simply change wording.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected as the aim of the A3.
